subject: general
question: Q is married to L. L is the sister of T. T is the daughter of R. R is the brother of P. P is married to N. N is the father of Q. How is P related to L ?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496368278e51fd33f2bee9b301a733a33389bdc9d0f2d4fae5af0b40056affd1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69174f76f0ce92230abb01fc88160124af35883cdcefd89a8e35798827a0083c.png] 

Clearly, P is L's father sister.

Hence, ‘**Father's sister**’ is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__****Please note that here since L is married to Q and Q is the Son of P and N. There is a possibility that P is the mother - in - law of L. But as per the options given here and the answer key provide in the official paper, Option 4: Father's sister is the correct answer.**
